findings.evidence: The same-namespace file `TauCeti/Algebra/Lie/UniversalEnveloping/Functoriality.lean:54` uses `namespace TauCeti.UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra` and spells `_root_.UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ι R` out at lines 74, 80-82, 90-92, 100-101 with no notation; repo-wide `grep "local notation"` finds only single-symbol precedents (`H`, `C`, `𝕢`, `κ[·]`).
findings.fix: Delete both notations and write `_root_.UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ι R` / `(_root_.UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ι R).toLinearMap` in full, as the sibling file already does. `local notation "U"` is fine and may stay.
findings.issue: `local notation "ueaι"` and `local notation "ueaιₗ"` are gratuitous ad-hoc alphabetic tokens with no mathematical precedent ("uea" is not standard for anything), and `ueaιₗ` appears in the statements of the public lemmas `ι_range_le_pbwFiltration_one` (105), `pbwFiltration_eq_iSup_pow` (121), `pbwFiltration_succ_eq_sup` (127) and `pbwFiltration_one` (132), so the rendered API refers to a token no downstream file can use.

findings.evidence: `TauCeti/Algebra/WordFiltration.lean:71` `prod_map_mem_wordFiltration` and `TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/CliffordAlgebra/Filtration.lean:161` `prod_map_ι_mem_filtration`; all other PBW names in this file match their Clifford counterparts exactly (`filtration_le_iff`/`pbwFiltration_le_iff`, `ι_mem_filtration_one`/`ι_mem_pbwFiltration_one`, etc.).
findings.issue: `prod_ι_mem_pbwFiltration` drops the `map` that its two siblings for the identical statement carry, breaking the naming pattern a user would guess from the Clifford API and from the generic lemma it delegates to.

summary: Names are otherwise conventional and match the Clifford API they were factored from, but the PBW file introduces ad-hoc word notation `ueaι`/`ueaιₗ` that leaks into public statements, and one lemma name breaks the `prod_map_…` pattern used by its two siblings in this same PR.
